description: NHS England primary-care prescribing for a drug (official NHSBSA English Prescribing Dataset, monthly, ~2 months behind; the raw data behind OpenPrescribing.net): items, actual cost (GBP) and quantity, grouped by region, ICB, GP practice or product presentation, largest first. Match on BNF chemical substance or presentation name. Open Government Licence, no key. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

area.description: Only rows whose ICB or region name contains this text, e.g. manchester (optional)

drug.description: Drug name contained in the BNF chemical substance or presentation name, e.g. metformin, atorvastatin, semaglutide (2 to 60 characters)

groupBy.description: region, icb, practice or presentation (default icb)

month.description: Month as YYYYMM, e.g. 202608 (default latest published)

name: search_openprescribing
title: Search Openprescribing
